name: Omacounter
author: stoneynutcase
description: Old-school hit counters in the Omarchy bar: YouTube subscribers, video likes and views, GitHub stars, issues, pull requests and cloners, Mastodon followers, posts and hashtag activity, Discord server members and members online. More counters are coming; every source is one small file.

barWidget.description: Click: counter panel. Middle click: refresh now. Right click: notification summary.

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often counters are fetched again unless a counter sets its own interval. YouTube updates its statistics at most every few minutes and every fetch costs one API quota unit of 10,000 a day.

schema.label: Number style on the bar
schema.description: short: 12.3K. long: 12,345. A counter can override this with its own style. The panel always shows the exact number.

schema.label: Bar layout
schema.description: all: every counter side by side. cycle: one counter at a time, rotating.

schema.label: Cycle interval (seconds)
schema.description: How long each counter stays on the bar in cycle mode.

schema.label: Counters on the bar
schema.description: Limit how many counters the bar shows (0 = all). The panel always lists every counter.

schema.label: Bar width budget (px)
schema.description: Widest the counters may be on the bar. Counters that do not fit collapse into a +N chip; hover it for their numbers, click it for the panel. 0 = no limit.

schema.label: Glyph colour
schema.description: Default colour of every counter's glyph: foreground, accent, urgent, muted, or #rrggbb. Empty follows the bar. A counter's own glyphColor or color wins.

schema.label: Number colour
schema.description: Default colour of every counter's number, same values. Empty follows the bar. A counter's own textColor or color wins.

schema.label: Monochrome
schema.description: Drop every brand and per-counter colour, on the bar and in the panel. Glyphs and numbers take the glyph and number colours above, which is the bar foreground unless set.
